description: A night or dusk field with tall palms at the edges. Several men in wide-brimmed straw and slouch hats, some mounted and some standing, with rifles and bandoliers, stand in a loose group behind a central scene. In the foreground a saddled brown horse stands riderless, held by a man in a light linen shirt and hat. On the grass beside them lie a straw hat and a machete-like blade. Painted in a dark, realistic oil style.
